Jimmy Kimmel on Monday said he knows where President Donald Trump’s eventual destination is ― and it’s going to be a lot hotter than Florida.

“I’m a religious person, so in theory, I go to heaven,” Trump said.

“Do you think you’re going to heaven?” Douthat asked.

“I hope so,” Trump replied. “I don’t want to go to hell.”

Kimmel had some bad news for the president.

“Well, you are going to hell,” he said.

The studio audience erupted in cheers and applause.

“A little weird to say, because Jesus told us, ‘Judge not, lest ye be judged,’” Kimmel said. “But in this case, who are we kidding? Ye are going to live with the devil himself.”

Then, he went even further.

“You are going to hell. You are gonna open your eyes and pray you’re watching ‘South Park,’” Kimmel said. “You will be in hell.”
